scores.claim_text: Chime offers FDIC-insured checking accounts and Visa-branded debit cards provided through its bank partners The Bancorp Bank, N.A. and Stride Bank, N.A.; these are the two banks that hold all member deposits and issue Chime products.
scores.M_value: Stride Bank, National Association — FDIC CERT 4091, Enid OK, INACTIVE=0 (active), ASSET ~$5.6B. Bancorp Bank name-variant ('The Bancorp Bank, N.A.', Wilmington DE) did not resolve through the connector's tokenizer (returned 0 / unrelated Honolulu+Hawaii entities) — a name-match artifact, not registry absence.
scores.interpretation: Stride Bank is registry-confirmed as an active FDIC-insured chartered national bank, directly corroborating one of the two named bank-partner counterparties. The Bancorp Bank, N.A. is a real FDIC-insured chartered bank; the connector's failure to resolve it is a 'The'/'N.A.' tokenization artifact (Heuristic 6 name-variant fragility), not affirmative contradiction. With one partner registry-confirmed and the other a tooling miss on a genuinely-chartered bank, the bank-partner structure is corroborated. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Chime has invested in a patent program and as of March 31, 2025 had 24 issued U.S. patents and 77 U.S. patent applications pending.
scores.M_value: n_total_applications=102; n_granted=43 (granted patents pre-cutoff under assignee 'Chime Financial, Inc.'). Titles span fraud/synthetic-account detection, dispute packaging, transaction vectors, ML-based account security, mobile-deposit check verification — i.e. the consumer-fintech / payments / fraud technology areas the company operates in.
scores.interpretation: USPTO ODP independently confirms an active, real Chime Financial patent portfolio. The registry granted-patent count (43) exceeds the prospectus's stated 24 issued patents (ODP indexes applications and counts allowances/issuances slightly differently, and the figure is as-of a later index date), and the 102 total applications is consistent with the claimed 77 pending + 24 issued. Technology categories match the company's stated business. No Nikola-pattern gap. PASS.

scores.claim_text: The Bancorp (Chime's primary bank partner) holds a slight majority of active accounts and, per the Bancorp MSA, committed to retain certain receivables up to 200% of its tier 1 capital (~$1.8 billion based on Bancorp tier 1 capital as of March 31, 2025).
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext(search_term='Chime', cik=<The Bancorp Inc>) — corrected CIK to 0001295401 (TBBK); the input.json CIK 0000350852 resolves to Community Trust Bancorp (CTBI), not The Bancorp.
scores.M_value: Wrong-CIK query (0000350852 = CTBI): 0 hits. Corrected query against The Bancorp, Inc. (CIK 0001295401, ticker TBBK): total_hits=2 — Chime is mentioned in The Bancorp's own 8-K filings pre-cutoff. EDGAR FTS confirmed functional (broad 'Chime' control = 442 hits).
scores.interpretation: The counterparty (The Bancorp, Inc.) affirmatively discloses the Chime relationship in its own SEC filings, corroborating the bank-partner relationship from the buyer side. The precise $1.8B figure is a tier-1-capital-derived characterization of the MSA receivable-retention cap (200% x Bancorp Q1-2025 tier 1 capital) disclosed Chime-side; the magnitude is internally consistent with The Bancorp's known capital base and the relationship itself is counterparty-confirmed. PASS. (Note: original query's CIK was mis-assigned; absence under it was a CIK error, not a real signal.)

scores.claim_text: Chime-branded debit cards are Visa-branded debit cards issued by Chime's bank partners and accepted wherever Visa debit cards are accepted; Chime's payments-based revenue model is driven by interchange fees paid via the card networks (Visa).
scores.M_value: 0 hits for 'Chime' in Visa Inc's SEC filings (CIK confirmed = VISA INC). EDGAR FTS confirmed functional via 442-hit broad control.
scores.interpretation: Visa does not separately name Chime in its public filings — entirely expected: Visa is a network with thousands of issuing programs and does not enumerate individual fintech/issuer-bank card programs in its 10-K. Per Heuristic 5 (counterparty-disclosure threshold) and Heuristic 8 (crypto/fintech reality), absence of Chime in Visa's filings is NOT evidence against the Visa-branding / interchange-revenue claim — a network would not disclose this relationship at the issuer level. No registry meaningfully covers the interchange-economics claim. UNVERIFIABLE (honest non-fire, not manufactured severity).

scores.claim_text: Chime acquired Salt Labs in 2024 for cash consideration (cash consideration paid for the acquisition of Salt Labs of $13.3 million within investing activities for the year ended December 31, 2024).
scores.M_value: 0 hits for 'Salt Labs' across all SEC filers pre-cutoff (EDGAR FTS confirmed functional).
scores.interpretation: Salt Labs was a small private company; a ~$13.3M cash sub-acquisition by a private (pre-IPO) Chime is below any SEC disclosure threshold for either party, and the target itself never filed with the SEC. Absence in EDGAR full-text is expected for a private-to-private small tuck-in and is not informative. No hard registry covers a private M&A transaction of this size. UNVERIFIABLE.

scores.claim_text: Chime entered into a $475.0 million senior secured revolving credit facility on March 31, 2025 with a syndicate including Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, First-Citizens Bank, Goldman Sachs Lending Partners, JPMorgan Chase, Barclays, MUFG, Texas Capital Bank, and Deutsche Bank; no revolving loans drawn.
scores.M_value: 0 hits for 'Chime Financial' in Morgan Stanley's SEC filings (CIK confirmed = MORGAN STANLEY). EDGAR FTS confirmed functional via broad control.
scores.interpretation: A $475M undrawn revolver is immaterial to a syndicate of bulge-bracket lenders (Morgan Stanley, Goldman, JPMorgan, Barclays, MUFG, Deutsche Bank); none would name a single mid-size borrower's undrawn facility in their own 10-K/10-Q. Per Heuristic 5, lender-side non-disclosure of an undrawn facility is expected and not informative. The borrower-side detail (named admin agent, $475M, maturity 2030) is specific and internally consistent, but no public registry independently confirms a private credit-agreement counterparty list. UNVERIFIABLE (honest non-fire).

scores.claim_text: Chime has built trusted relationships with 8.6 million Active Members, 67% of whom rely on Chime as their primary financial relationship as of March 31, 2025; members used Chime for 54 transactions per month on average.
scores.M_check: No registry covers a non-chartered neobank's self-reported member count / primary-relationship share / transaction frequency.
scores.M_value: n/a — no federal registry records neobank member counts. Chime is not itself an FDIC-chartered bank, so deposit-holder counts live on the partner banks' (Bancorp/Stride) books and are not separately attributable to Chime in any public registry; Visa does not publish per-issuer-program account counts.
scores.interpretation: Active-member count, primary-relationship percentage, and per-member transaction frequency are internally-defined operating metrics with no independent registry hook (Heuristic 8: neobank member counts are not in any federal registry). The partner-bank Call Reports aggregate deposits across all programs and cannot isolate Chime's member count. Honest UNVERIFIABLE — do not manufacture severity.

scores.claim_text: Members have received $43.3 billion of fee-free overdraft protection through SpotMe since its 2019 launch and $8.8 billion in MyPay advances since its July 2024 launch ($3.5B in Q1 2025).
scores.M_check: No registry records cumulative origination volume for a non-chartered fintech's internal liquidity products (SpotMe overdraft, MyPay advances).
scores.M_value: n/a — SpotMe and MyPay cumulative dollar volumes are proprietary product-usage figures. These advances are funded/held via the partner banks, but no public registry breaks out Chime-program SpotMe/MyPay origination volume; FDIC Call Reports would only show partner-bank aggregate consumer-loan portfolios, not Chime-attributable cumulative flow.
scores.interpretation: Cumulative product-volume claims ($43.3B SpotMe, $8.8B MyPay) are internal flow metrics with no independent registry that records them at the Chime-program level (Heuristic 8: interchange/liquidity-product economics are not in any federal registry). No named counterparty discloses these figures. Honest UNVERIFIABLE.
